summary: This standards-track memo specifies two transport mappings of the RAQMON information model from RFC 4710. One uses TCP as a native transport and the other uses SNMP, to carry data from a RAQMON Data Source to a RAQMON Report Collector. It was later updated by RFC 8996.

eli5.summary: Quality reports need a delivery truck. This picks two kinds of trucks, TCP and SNMP, for carrying reports from a gadget to the collector.
